caption: Mexico's executive throne is still empty. One dollar claims it. clashofegos.lol

slides.say: There's a throne for executives in Mexico. And right now, nobody is sitting on it.
Clash of Egos is a satirical leaderboard. Claiming the crown costs one dollar. That's the opening bid.
Anyone who beats the current bid by at least a dollar takes the throne instantly. No refunds. Hubris is final.
Every bid feeds a vault that pays out to the season champion on December tenth.
Founders post about leadership every day. Yet nobody has paid one dollar to prove it. Who goes first?
Claim it at clash of egos dot lol. Follow for more.
